en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.950 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Archangel Jibril (as) came to Yusuf (as) while he was in prison and said:
'O’ Yusuf, say after every obligatory prayer:
‘O’ Allah (swt), make for me a relief and an escape from my affairs, and grant me sustenance from where I expect and from where I do not expect”.
